items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Ray Charles; the mention is made by the interviewer in the context of a story about Gleason.

ctx.x: And didn't you also say that, Gleason later on did it on the West Coast?
Yeah. Duke Ellington and Ray Charles. And when I found out about it, and I was at DownBeat by then, I would not let him write about those people. Because I found out that he was on their payroll.
